title: Test Gap: Delayed T2 ugprade path test
author: Javier-Tan
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Low

### Description of the test gap

We should have a test where T2 upgrade path test where one LC has a delayed upgrade

### Affected Area

upgrade_path

### Impact of missing tests and proposed tests

This test gap will help us to see the affects if an LC has a delayed upgrade compared to it's peers

comments.author: StormLiangMS
comments.body: **Test Gap Status Check (2026-03-11)**: This test gap is still open. No delayed T2 upgrade path test found where one LC has a delayed upgrade compared to peers. :raised_hands: **Help wanted** - community contributions welcome.
